content_of_post_to_answer: Why is it so hard to be consistent with studying, habits, and goals?
answer: Consistency is often treated as a discipline problem, but many people are actually fighting a design problem. A goal that depends on feeling motivated every day will eventually collapse because motivation changes with stress, sleep, and circumstances. The deeper shift is moving from asking “How do I force myself to keep going?” to “How do I make returning easier after I fall off?” Real consistency is not never breaking the chain; it is shortening the distance between quitting and restarting.
